text:
The Mitch in Alexandria.

The venue
Local neighbourhood pub with a pizza oven and a couple of craft beers on tap with some pub classics on the menu. Lounging area in the front with some TVs, a pool table out the back, and outside seating along Mitchell Road. Good for a feed or a casual drink.

The deal
Drain the taps: $4.99 for any schooner. Monday 8:30pm to close. Very rare to find a schooner in Sydney where the price starts with a 4. Found on duskroute.com.

The beer
Philter Sydney Stout 4.2%. Creamy with a light finish. Similar to Guinness but less bitter. A beer I could easily sit on or skull. 8/10
